why: Design and spot keep being argued in the same threads, so telling 'what it looks like' from 'where it goes' is the recurring hard edge in this batch.

why.T3-097: The item is the leftover April Fools CSS being pointed out and quietly fixed, i.e. getting past the sub's prank styling and restoring it, not playing inside the takeover (T3-023) nor objecting to joke posts (T3-032).

why.T3-070: Placers are handed what they need to reproduce the work - the spot link, the Tampermonkey template overlay, and an explanation of how the overlay shows the finished Emil - which is directions and templates shared to follow rather than the event explained (T3-016) or coordinates merely asked for (T3-034); the Discord and new-thread notes are context around circulating the template.

why.T3-004: The bulk settles what the icon looks like - a separate relay design instead of vandalizing Kebble, corners, the screen mark read as a P, the open 52-pixel plan - so the design is the primary doing.
why.T3-020: Several concepts also choose where it goes - another location at x=44&y=47, the bump left between Halo and the cat, the conclusion that another location is needed - which T3-004's gate does not reach.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: Placing only T3-004 would record the icon's design but drop the room's repeated choice of where on the canvas to put it - the moved location, the left bump to fit between neighbours, the search for another spot.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: Different concepts announce and weigh locations for the watch - the alternative spot, the left bump to clear Halo and the cat, the 'find somewhere else' conclusion - satisfying T3-020's gate of choosing a spot.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-020; dropping it would lose the location choice but leave the icon's design readable.

why.T3-041: The one concept proposes a second NieR picture (a 2B 9S portrait) beside the room's existing work, which is adding a piece to the room's work rather than proposing its first mark (T3-033) or a bare call for hands (T3-002).

why.T3-001: Members of the room stage their own fakes (Pebble is back; Apple buys FitBit and shuts Pebble down), reveal them (APRIL FOOLS, the calendar), and the thread replies inside those fakes, which is the room's own April Fools staging.
why.T3-032: Three or more concepts object to those jokes as hurtful or unwelcome - 'it just hurt too much', 'too soon', 'don't mock the dead', downvotes for the fake-out - so the objecting is added.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: Placing only T3-001 would record the fakes staged but drop the sustained objection to them as hurtful and unwanted, which is a distinct practice in the item.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: Concept C0281061 'too soon', C1242548 'don't mock the dead', C0098411 'it just hurt too much' and C0074275 'downvotes for you' object to the sub's April Fools posts as hurtful, satisfying T3-032's gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-032; dropping it would lose the objection reading but leave the staging of the fakes intact.

why.T3-068: The point of the fight is turning another's sign (Kebble) into the room's own sign (Pebble) by rewriting its K as P - converting a neighbour's mark rather than destroying or blacking it out (T3-006) or taking its space (T3-061).

why.T3-002: The material is calls to come and place for the room's Mario Kart art ('needs reinforcements', 'we need your cooperation to keep him in shape'), i.e. calling the room's members/placers in rather than recruiting kindred subs (T3-062) or asking another room as a group (T3-084).

why.T3-004: Most concepts work out what the mark looks like - rainbow in the letter holes, multicoloured letters, outline then fill, a clean black border with yellow text, fitting the cover - so design is the leading doing.
why.T3-020: Concepts also choose where it goes - 47,910, then 13,862 for more space, the 280,420 build, moving the bear to center r/place - which T3-004 cannot carry.
why.T3-041: Concepts also add further pieces beside the existing bear - Kid A, Amnesiac, The Bends, four albums, a creep - i.e. extending the room's work, which is neither the design nor the spot.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: Only T3-004 would settle the mark's look but drop the room's repeated choice of coordinates and re-location (47,910; 13,862; 280,420; centering the bear).
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: Different concepts announce and shift the spot for the build, satisfying T3-020's gate of choosing where the mark goes.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-020; dropping it would lose the location choices but leave the design readable.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: Placing only T3-004 would settle the mark's look and T3-004+T3-020 the spot, but neither reaches the proposals of further pieces beside the existing bear (Kid A, Amnesiac, The Bends, four albums).
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: Different concepts propose adding second pictures beside the existing bear, satisfying T3-041's gate of extending the room's work.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-041; dropping it would lose the added pieces but leave the main design and spot readable.

why.T3-005: Attackers are named (r/loltyler1, Estonia, 'somebody's trying to take us over') and the room is called to fight back and hold the line (DEFEND THE FORT, mounting guard for hours, holding ground), so the attack and the fight lead rather than watch-and-repair (T3-021).

why.T3-039: A neighbour asks Pebble to go elsewhere and the drawing is shifted to a new uncontested spot, which is yielding space when asked.
why.T3-024: Other concepts keep the room's work off the guarded neighbours' art by the room's own choice - bumping left to clear Halo, stopping messing with theirs, ceasing to infringe on Kebble - restraint unasked, which T3-039 does not reach.
why.T3-035: Other concepts ask the holders of space for room ('Could I please have some space', suggesting asking for space below Kebble), the ask-a-host act.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: Only T3-039 would record the move when asked but drop the room's own unasked restraint in going around and ceasing to overwrite Halo's and Kebble's works.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: Different concepts keep the room's work off others' art by the room's own choice (the slight left shift to spare Halo, stopping messing with theirs, ceasing to infringe on Kebble), satisfying T3-024's gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-024; dropping it would lose the unasked restraint but leave the yielding and moving readable.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: Both T3-039 and T3-024 leave out the requests addressed to the holders of the space for room to build; a single placement would drop the asking itself.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: Different concepts address a request for room to the room that holds the space ('Could I please have some space somewhere', the suggestion to ask for space below Kebble), satisfying T3-035's gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-035; dropping it would lose the asking-for-space but leave the yielding and restraint readable.

why.T3-070: Same material as position 2: placers are given the spot and the Tampermonkey template overlay with an explanation of how it overlays the finished Emil, i.e. directions and templates shared to follow.

why.T3-063: A moderator removes an outside faction's r/place post because it has no relevance to NieR - a canvas post handled under the sub's standing relevance rule, not gathering (T3-015) nor a rule change (T3-185).

why.T3-009: The material marks the room's own finished Emil as achieved - a perfect ending, a great achievement, pride and congratulations - which is celebrating the finished work, not a victory over rivals (T3-154) nor a plain account of its fate (T3-073).

why.T3-029: The passages grieve the unfinished icon - the bare 'Awww :(' and the regret that the midway move left it incomplete - so mourning leads.
why.T3-073: Other concepts report what happened to the work after the close (the final tally of both locations, the screen portion made before the end) - the account of its fate, which T3-029 does not carry.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: Only T3-029 would voice the grief but drop the reported tally of what happened to the icon - both locations, the screen portion, the move - after the close.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: Different concepts report what became of the work after the close (the final tally of the two locations, the screen portion left), satisfying T3-073's gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-073; dropping it would lose the account but leave the mourning readable.

why.T3-011: The material is neighbours offering, seeking and giving help with each other's works (r/monero has NieR's back, 'we should go and help Estonia', help offered in return for their space), i.e. pixels sent to another room's work, rather than a border line settled (T3-010) or an alliance formed (T3-150).
